literal: With earth joined, tree-like they are; with eyes having joined, eyes-not-running they.
translation: Those who have eyes but do not look with graciousness are merely like trees rooted in the earth.
modern: கண்கள் இருந்தும் பிறரிடம் இரக்கம் காட்டாதவர்கள், மண்ணில் நிலைத்து நிற்கும் மரங்களுக்கு ஒப்பானவர்கள்.
explanation: This couplet plays on the literal meaning of the Tamil word for graciousness, which implies the 'running' or extending of the eyes towards others. The poet states that people who possess physical eyes but fail to look upon others with empathy are no different from trees. Even though they exist in human form, their lack of compassion makes them as unfeeling and stationary as a tree rooted in the dirt.
